items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore suffered a shoulder injury (AC joint sprain) Thursday night vs Lions, ruled out for the game; doctors do not consider it serious, day-to-day with a chance to play next week vs Chargers but not a lock.
items.why: AC joint sprain from diving catch; Schefter source + Rapoport corroboration
items.implication: Monitor practice next week; short-term Bills WR targets redistribute
items.opportunity: Increased targets/snaps for other BUF WRs if he misses Week 3

items.text: Nico Collins hurt hamstring at Wednesday practice (history of missing 5 games in 2024); ran 37/42 routes Week 1. Schefter: not believed serious but Week 2 status vs Bengals in jeopardy; DNP Thursday.
items.why: Hamstring + MRI/history; high route share shows alpha role
items.implication: If OUT, Texans WR/TE hierarchy elevates; Stroud efficiency hit
items.opportunity: Routes/targets for Hutchinson, Boutte, Noel, Schultz

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson says 'I'm ready to go' after missing Week 1 (ankle). Unclear volume vs Stevenson, but timing perfect: AJ Brown IR (high ankle, 4-6 weeks), Pats desperate for explosives + favorable upcoming schedule (PIT/JAX/BUF etc before bye).
items.why: Self-reported ready + Brown absence creates playmaker vacuum + schedule
items.implication: Handcuff/change-of-pace upside spikes; monitor snap share vs Stevenson
items.opportunity: Explosive carries/routes/goal-line if earns larger role

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers DNP again Thursday due to last week's knee (meniscus) surgery; has yet to practice since procedure. Missed Week 1, status for Week 2 vs Chargers uncertain.
items.implication: Mayer continues as primary TE if OUT

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey DNP second straight day (ribs from Week 1 hit), making it unlikely he plays Sunday vs Raiders.
items.implication: LAC WR targets open; Johnston primary beneficiary
items.opportunity: Snap/route/target share bump for Quentin Johnston, Tre Harris

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) DNP Thursday (second straight); Ja'Kobi Lane on IR (wrist). If Flowers OUT vs Saints, Ravens WR order: Bateman, Devontez Walker, Wester, Sarratt, Moore.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs + Lane IR removes depth
items.implication: Bateman becomes clear WR1 if Flowers sits; Andrews target share already elevated

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE Week 2 vs IND: 24% target share (tied team lead, 2nd-highest career) in Chiefs debut + 21/24 RB touches through 3Q (74% snaps); Indy just gave Henry 163 yds/3 TDs. RB1 overall in range of outcomes if healthy.
items.why: Elite early usage + soft run matchup

items.text: Bucky Irving LOVE vs CLE: Career-high 26% target share, out-routed Gainwell by 8, all RB red-zone touches; CLE allowed 121 rush yds/4.8 YPC.
DeVonta Smith LOVE @ TEN: 27% target share + 13.7 aDOT (3 deep looks) Week 1; TEN allowed 85% catch rate/16 YPR to Jets WRs + 6th-most PPG to WRs recently. Bounce-back expected.
Travis Etienne HATE @ BAL: Matched Kendre Miller rush attempts Week 1 (most FPs via air); Kamara expected back squeezes role further; Saints 8.5-pt dogs = poor rush script.
items.why: Split backfield + Kamara return + underdog script
items.implication: Sit/flex only; Miller handcuff value if Kamara limited

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr. HATE vs SEA: Only 8% target share Week 1 (5th on team), zero RZ looks; SEA 3rd-fewest PPG to WRs since last season.

Dalton Kincaid LOVE vs DET: 69% route participation (higher than any 2025 game), 77% snaps (highest since 2024 W9); DET just allowed 27 FPs to opposing TEs. Efficiency + role expansion = breakout path.
Ashton Jeanty LOVE @ LAC: Utilization Score 99 in Kubiak debut (only Bijan higher); overreacted to injury scare. 19% target share recent + 25+ touches in 3 of last 4.
Harold Fannin Jr. HATE @ TB: 14% target share (lowest completed game since 2025 W5), 21 rec yds; more competition (Concepcion/Boston) + Watson + low implied total.
